title: Spiked Spear Tips
description: This is a pack that adds Spiked Spear Tips to the spear heads.
body:
Changes the spear textures to look like they are a **harpoon**

Take your Minecraft combat experience to the next level with the Spiked Spear Tips resource pack! This pack gives spears a fresh new look by adding detailed spiked tips that make them feel stronger, sharper, and way more exciting to use. The designs fit naturally into Minecraft’s style, so they feel like they could have been part of the game from the start. Whether you’re exploring caves, fighting mobs at night, or playing with friends on a server, the upgraded spears make every battle feel more immersive and satisfying.

Each spear has its own unique look that adds extra personality without changing the classic Minecraft vibe players already love. The added spikes give the weapons a tougher and more realistic appearance, making them stand out both in your inventory and while you’re using them. This pack also pairs well with other texture packs and visual upgrades, making it perfect for survival worlds, medieval builds, RPG gameplay, or PvP servers.

If you want your weapons to look cooler while still keeping the vanilla feel of Minecraft, Spiked Spear Tips is a simple but awesome upgrade that makes every adventure feel more epic.
